# Aura

Aura offers several colour schemes together with custom background images and a coloured frame around the workspace. It adds an alternate rounded layout, card-style note views and a floating status bar, and pairs file and folder icons so callouts and folders stand out.

![Aura screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shadowash8/obsidian-aura/HEAD/assets/showcase-preview.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Aura"
    author: "shadowash8"
    repo:   "shadowash8/obsidian-aura"
    slug:   "aura"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/aura"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/shadowash8/obsidian-aura"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/shadowash8/obsidian-aura/HEAD/assets/showcase-preview.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Customize your workspace with multiple colorschemes, custom background images, and a colorful frame. Apply an alternate rounded layout, card-style note views, floating status bar, and coordinated file & folder icons to make callouts and folders pop."
}
```
